thread:
Anna Nguyen: PR #3421 — migration guide (dedicated -> private) ready for review. Docs preview is failing CI, can someone take this?

CI Preview Bot: preview for PR 3421
- markdown-lint: 2 errors
  - MD031: Fenced code blocks not surrounded by blank lines (file: docs/migration/private.md:45)
  - MD0XY: Emoji in heading triggers vale/markdown rule (file: docs/migration/private.md:12) 
- linkcheck: 1 broken internal anchor (#private-deploy)

Sam L: I can review now. Quick question — is the emoji in the H2 deliberate? Looks like "⚠️" in "## ⚠️ Private deploy notes"

Anna Nguyen: yeah that was to call out warnings; it came from a copy of the old guide. If it's causing lint flakiness, I'd prefer to move it inline or escape it.

Miguel Ortiz: quick fix suggestion: remove emoji from heading and add an inline badge in the paragraph. Also add the missing anchor or change the link to #private-deployment. Example patch:
```
- ## ⚠️ Private deploy notes
+ ## Private deploy notes

Add note: :warning: Some setups require extra network config.
```

Sam L: LGTM for the heading change. I can push a tiny patch and run the linter locally:
```
make docs-lint
./scripts/preview.sh --pr 3421
```

Docs Reviewer Bot: @Sam L added review request status: change requested -> ready for re-review

Anna Nguyen: CI re-run triggered (by @Anna). Please hold merge until linkcheck passes. Planning to merge in today's 17:00 slot if green.

CI Preview Bot: re-run complete — markdown-lint: PASS; linkcheck: 1 remaining broken anchor (#private-deployment vs #private-deploy)

Sam L: fixed anchor, pushed. No other failures.

CI Preview Bot: preview succeeded ✅

Anna Nguyen: thanks all — marking with label 'merge-when-green' and will merge at 17:00 unless any objections. :shipit:

Miguel Ortiz: quick note — opened a follow-up issue to add a doc style guideline about emoji in headings to avoid future flakiness.

Sam L: +1
